Risa Farm House, a distinguished project under the Risala Group specializing in housing and high-rise developments, is looking for an experienced Sales & Marketing Manager to lead its sales and marketing efforts across various group projects. The ideal candidate will manage the sales team, develop and execute strategic marketing plans, set and monitor sales targets, and ensure the successful implementation of marketing campaigns. This role requires strong leadership, proven sales expertise, and the ability to drive business growth through innovative strategies, corporate networking, and effective team management. Immediate joining is preferred, with a start date targeted for the first week of November 2025.Key ResponsibilitiesTeam Leadership & Sales Management:  Lead and supervise the Sales & Marketing Executives in their daily activities and ensure achievement of sales targets. Assign, track, and evaluate sales goals on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis. Collect and analyze sales reports and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement. Conduct regular training and coaching sessions to enhance team capabilities. Ensure timely follow-up on leads to maintain a high sales conversion rate.Client & Corporate Relations:  Build and maintain strong relationships with high-value and corporate clients. Conduct meetings, deliver presentations, and participate in site visits with potential investors and buyers. Organize and lead client engagement initiatives to boost customer satisfaction and trust. Represent the company at property expos, seminars, and networking events to increase corporate visibility and brand recognition.Marketing & Business Development:  Work closely with the digital media team to develop advertisements, video content, and social media campaigns. Design and implement marketing strategies aimed at increasing brand awareness and generating qualified leads. Monitor market trends and competitor activities to uncover new business opportunities. Plan and execute promotional events, exhibitions, and campaigns to raise project awareness. Coordinate with vendors, media partners, and design teams to ensure smooth and effective campaign delivery.Reporting & Performance Analysis:  Prepare monthly and quarterly performance reports for senior management. Assess the effectiveness of marketing and sales campaigns and recommend strategic adjustments based on sales data and market insights. Collaborate with top management to set revenue goals and align business plans accordingly.Required QualificationsEducation:  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related discipline.Experience:  5 to 8 years of proven experience in Sales & Marketing within horizontal and vertical real estate projects. Demonstrated success in meeting sales targets and managing high-performing teams. Strong leadership, communication, and presentation skills are essential. Proficiency in CRM software, Microsoft Office, and digital marketing coordination is required. Candidates must possess strategic thinking, negotiation skills, and sound decision-making abilities.Preferred Qualifications and BenefitsThe company offers a competitive salary package, including a base salary, attractive incentives, sales commissions, and allowances. Employees benefit from company-provided leads and comprehensive marketing support. There are significant opportunities for career growth within the group’s expanding portfolio of projects. The work environment is professional and dynamic, fostering innovation and development.Job Type: Full-time  Salary Range: Rs60,000 - Rs80,000 per month  Location: G-11 Markaz, Islamabad (In-person)/Skills
